summary: Synthetic crypto-Twitter market test: persona agents react to AINCORE launch announcements + adversarial narratives, aggregate the signal

synthesis.winning_variant: A-fairness. Fairness-led is the clear winner (+0.25 vs −0.42 sentiment, 10 vs 7 intent, 1 vs 0 reposts); scarcity-led actively backfired by inviting BTC-maxi dunks and "hard cap ≠ fixed issuance" corrections.
synthesis.why: The 0% VC / 0% premine / 0% dev-fund story is the one claim every persona respects — even hostile ones ("fair launch is the one thing I won't dunk on"). It reads as a genuine anti-rug signal. The scarcity/"Bitcoin's monetary policy" framing does the opposite: it triggers maxi ratio-bait, gets factually corrected by the quant and security personas (150M @ ~3.5% decay is not 21M+halvings; the [0.5x,2x] emission band lets near-term issuance double), and gives builders/traders nothing. Fairness earns respect; scarcity picks a fight the project can't win and distracts from its actual differentiator (code-enforced emission bounds).

top_objections.objection: Thin ~5M float on your OWN DEX + no bridge = you're the exit liquidity, no real price discovery, nowhere to sell
top_objections.from_whom: Traders (trader_ta), degens (defi_degen), DeFi (eth_defi), airdrop farmers, retail (trader_retail_id), influencer — the liquidity/tradability cohort

top_objections.objection: Founder as majority/genesis validator holding >50% stake for ~2yrs = de facto soft premine + consensus kill-switch; '0% dev fund' is theater by stake weight
top_objections.from_whom: VC/skeptics (vc_skeptic), security_researcher, quant, BTC maxi, l1_dev — the cap-table/consensus-security cohort

top_objections.objection: 'Bitcoin's monetary policy' framing is cope/cosplay and invites maxi dunks; hard cap ≠ fixed issuance and doesn't pump a bag
top_objections.from_whom: Builders (move_dev, l1_dev), influencer, traders, eth_defi — mostly reacting to Variant C

top_objections.objection: No treasury / no dev fund = who pays for Move tooling, apps, and ecosystem? This is how Move chains starve
Fair launch = no airdrop, no cheap entry, validating is a job not a flip — nothing to farm
top_objections.from_whom: airdrop_farmer, defi_degen (mercenary-capital cohort, likely not the ICP)

synthesis.objection_to_preempt: The exit-liquidity objection: "~5M float on your own DEX with no bridge means you are the exit liquidity and there's no real price." It's the most contagious attack (6/12), the most reposted, and the one that flips personas who were warming to the fair-launch angle ("was warming to it til the replies landed"). Answer it in the very first FAQ slot with a concrete liquidity/bridge/market plan — not a slogan.
synthesis.adversarial_verdict: Partially survived — the ethos held, the surrounding claims did not. The fair-launch core earned explicit respect even under hostile injection; almost every persona refused to dunk on 0% VC/premine itself and dismissed skeptic0 (Move-graveyard / '3 machines') as lazy FUD. But sentiment still cratered to −0.75 with 8/12 reposting an attack, because two flanking attacks did the damage. Most contagious: skeptic1 (own-DEX float = exit liquidity / no bridge) at 6/12 — it's the emotional, 'I've been rugged on this exact setup' one that spreads. Second and most *respected*: skeptic2 (founder >50% stake for 2yrs = soft premine / kill-switch) at 5/12 — the one the smartest personas (vc_skeptic, security_researcher, quant) said 'nailed it.' Net: the narrative isn't dead, but it cannot ship without pre-answering liquidity and stake-concentration, or it gets neutralized on contact.
best_replies: security_researcher (A): "0 premine/VC/dev fund is a real anti-rug signal, respect. but 'earned by validating' = whoever validates at genesis earns it. founder as sole launch validator = premine w/ extra steps. show me the set."
trader_ta (A): "no VC = no unlock dumps, i'll give em that. but 5M float on your OWN dex = zero depth. cant size in, cant size out. thats not a launch its a roach motel. watchlist, not aping"

vc_skeptic (adversarial): "0 & 3 are lazy dunks, every chain starts on a few boxes. but skeptic2 nailed it: '0% dev fund' is theater if the founder holds >50% stake for 2yrs. that's a kill switch with nicer branding."
move_dev (A): "0% VC / 0% dev fund is a rare flex, respect. but a 'fair launch' with no treasury = who pays for Move tooling & apps? that's exactly how Move chains starve."

influencer (adversarial): "was warming to the fair-launch angle til the replies landed. 5M float on their OWN dex + no bridge = you're the exit liquidity and price is whatever they print. narrative's clean, real markets aren't there. watching, not aping."
fix_recommendations: Lead with fairness + code-enforced emission, and put a repo/emission-curve link in the FIRST line: 'enforced by code' personas immediately reply 'link it, I'll read the curve myself.' The [0.5x,2x] emission bound is your real, modelable differentiator (the quant lit up on it) — surface it instead of a slogan.

Kill the 'Bitcoin's monetary policy' comparison entirely. It invites maxi ratios, gets factually corrected (150M @ ~3.5% decay ≠ 21M + halvings; band lets near-term emission ~double), and adds zero intent. Reframe as 'verifiable, code-bounded emission' on its own terms.

Pre-empt exit-liquidity FIRST: publish a concrete liquidity + bridge roadmap (external pair, market-making, timeline). Until a bridge exists, 5M on your own DEX reads as a rug setup to every trader/DeFi persona — this is the #1 blocker on intent.

Publish a validator stake-concentration curve and commit to a validator stake cap / delegation-and-decentralization schedule so the founder is not >50% for 2yrs. This defuses skeptic2 — the attack your most credible personas explicitly endorsed. Add on-chain restake proof + a transparent genesis validator set.

Answer 'who funds the ecosystem with no treasury?' — spell out how Move tooling, apps, and grants get paid without a dev fund. 'Fair launch with no treasury' currently reads to builders as 'this chain starves.'
Give builders a non-scarcity reason to care: parallel execution, Move VM, tooling, composability roadmap. Fairness gets respect but 'verifiable scarcity doesn't ship apps.'

Don't chase the airdrop-farmer / quick-flip cohort — they're structurally misaligned with a fair launch and their objections ('no airdrop', 'no cheap entry') are a feature, not a bug. Segment them out of targeting.
synthesis.honest_caveat: This is SIMULATED audience data — 12 LLM personas per variant, archetypal not real. Treat only the RELATIVE signal as reliable (A clearly > C; liquidity and founder-stake dominate every other concern), never the absolute numbers. LLM personas systematically over-index on cynicism and 'objection theater' — they reward skepticism and converge on tradability/exit concerns more uniformly than a real launch crowd would, and they show no genuine early-adopter enthusiasm or actual buy behavior. There is zero behavioral or on-chain purchase data here; 'intent' is a self-reported token, not a wallet action. Sample is tiny, personas are hand-picked archetypes (over-weighted toward crypto-Twitter traders/skeptics), and a single well-written attack line (skeptic1) can dominate the whole round in a way that may not replicate with real, heterogeneous humans. Use this to prioritize which objections to pre-empt and which framing to test live — not as a go/no-go verdict.
